Open items for you to confirm (please reply inline):

Got it — first pass numbers attached. High-level summary here so Stephanie can pass to NovaPay quickly: 

High-level comparative TCO (baseline 35M tokens/mo, 75% utilization where applicable):
- Hosted API (usage-based): estimate $0.00095 per token (mixed model across medium-size LLMs); monthly ~ $33k (range $25k–$42k depending on model family). Pros: zero infra ops, fast to roll, automatic scaling. Cons: harder to meet strict VPC-only data residency for sensitive scoring flows.

- Dedicated (12mo reserved capacity): committed pool (equivalent of 6 A10G-class instances) — list commit ~ $22k/mo; effective $/token at 75% util ~ $0.00046/token (range $0.00035–$0.00060 across utilization scenarios). Pros: predictable spend, lower unit cost when utilized; supports stricter network controls. Cons: higher lock-in, requires utilization to realize savings.

- Private (on-prem / VPC-managed install): one-time infra + integration estimate ~$420k upfront (HW + license + 1yr support), plus $6k/mo ops/support; amortized over 36 months ~ $15k/mo -> effective ~$0.00043/token at 35M tokens but CapEx risk and longer procurement cycle. Pros: maximum control/compliance. Cons: long lead time and upfront cost.
